correctness.rationale: The eight cosets have a free involution C↔−C and centeredness is preserved, proving the global evenness restriction. The subgroup K of order five modulo 41 has exact coset-sum vector 41(2,2,3,3,3,3,2,2); for admissible q, H_q is cyclic of index eight and order 5(q−1). Removing the five q-multiples from all lifted representatives proves the exact deviations q(R_j−R_{j−h}); direct shift comparison yields the stated sawtooth N(H_q) and all five possibilities. CRT and PNT in AP rigorously establish the density formula. Standalone exact enumeration verifies 60 prime moduli and 480 lifted coset sums; the infinite proof does not depend on this finite check.

value.rationale: The number of centered cosets is a natural strengthening of the single-subgroup residue-sum test in the originating work. The theorem closes the *global possibility spectrum* at index eight, proves that all parity-admissible intermediate cases have infinitely many arithmetic realizations, and computes exact conditional and absolute prime densities. The conductor 41 is the first viable nontrivial odd-order octic local kernel, making this a motivated minimal natural family rather than an arbitrary finite slice. The theorem does not require a new general lifting lemma or a downstream density theorem for all subgroups.
